title: Fix follow button functionality and follower count display

requirements.summary: Fix the follow/unfollow button on UserProfilePage to trigger backend mutations, show loading states, update button labels, and refresh follower counts immediately
acceptanceCriteria: Tapping the Follow button triggers a backend follow call and the button enters a loading/disabled state
After a successful follow, the button label changes to 'Following' and follower count increments by 1
Tapping the Following button triggers a backend unfollow call and the button reverts to 'Follow' with follower count decremented by 1
Follower and following counts on the profile page reflect the updated values without requiring a page reload
If the backend call fails, an error toast is shown and the button state reverts

file_operations.description: Wire the follow/unfollow button to call the useFollowUser and useUnfollowUser mutation hooks from useQueries.ts. Add loading state during mutation (disable button, show loading indicator). On success, update the button label between 'Follow' and 'Following', and trigger immediate refetch of follower/following counts and isFollowing status. On error, show a toast notification using the Toaster component and revert button state. Ensure the button state reflects the current isFollowing status from the backend query.

requirements.summary: Wire up follow/unfollow React Query mutation hooks in useQueries.ts to call backend actor methods and invalidate relevant queries on success
acceptanceCriteria: useFollowUser and useUnfollowUser mutation hooks exist in useQueries.ts and call the correct backend actor methods
On mutation success, queries for the target user's profile and follower/following counts are invalidated and refetched
The isFollowing status is also refetched after follow/unfollow

file_operations.description: Add useFollowUser and useUnfollowUser mutation hooks using useMutation from React Query. The useFollowUser hook should call actor.followUser(targetPrincipal) and the useUnfollowUser hook should call actor.unfollowUser(targetPrincipal). On mutation success, invalidate the following query keys using queryClient.invalidateQueries: ['profile', targetPrincipal], ['followers', targetPrincipal], ['following', targetPrincipal], ['isFollowing', targetPrincipal], and ['notifications'] to ensure all related data is refetched. Also add useGetFollowers, useGetFollowing, and useIsFollowing query hooks if they don't already exist, each calling the appropriate backend actor method (getFollowers, getFollowing, isFollowing) with the target principal parameter.
